description: Source code for the StudentAttendance document in ERPNext, handling validation, setting dates, checking holidays, and ensuring data integrity for student attendance records.

classes.name: StudentAttendance
classes.description: Represents student attendance records with validation and utility methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the attendance record before saving.

methods.name: set_date
methods.description: Sets the attendance date based on the course schedule.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures either student group or course schedule is provided.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Checks that the date is not in the future and within the academic year.

methods.name: set_student_group
methods.description: Assigns student group based on course schedule.

methods.name: validate_student
methods.description: Verifies the student belongs to the specified student group.

methods.name: validate_duplication
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate attendance record exists.

methods.name: validate_is_holiday
methods.description: Checks if the date is a holiday and prevents attendance marking.
